This firm of accountants gives you the flexibility and freedom to mould work around your life - and not the other way around.

Flexibility is a real thing and not just a buzz word

The owners understand people have commitments outside of work; and they've taken every step possible to accommodate this.

This isn't a flexible working policy where people still feel tied to their desks the owners encourage people to make work fit around their home lives.

Whether that's family, hobbies, missing rush hour traffic or simply having an extra hour in bed before getting up in the morning that's fine with them.

A career path that is shaped around you

title: Receptionist
description: At Earnswood Medical Practice, we are committed to providing friendly, caring and professional support to our patients. We are looking for a welcoming and organised receptionist to join our busy team. As a first point of contact, you will help patients access the care they need, treating everyone with kindness, patience and respect. If you enjoy helping people and working as part of a team, we would love to hear from you. The following are the core responsibilities of the Receptionist. There may be, on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks. This will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels: Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system under the direction of the Operations Manager or Reception Supervisor. Process face to face, telephone and e-requests for appointments, dealing with daily administrative tasks regarding patient care. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately. Primary responsibilities Process appointment requests received in person, by telephone and electronically, following practice procedures. Answer incoming telephone calls courteously and professionally, responding to enquiries or directing callers to the appropriate colleague or service. Welcome patients and visitors, assist with enquiries and help patients access the care and support they need. Book, amend and cancel appointments accurately, including appointments requested following clinical triage. Support patients to use online services and appointment systems, offering assistance where needed. Process repeat prescription requests in line with practice procedures, referring medication queries to the appropriate clinician. Record and update patient information accurately, maintaining confidentiality at all times. Receive, record and pass on messages, correspondence and patient requests promptly to the appropriate team. Complete daily administrative tasks relating to patient care, including registrations, document handling and electronic tasks as required. Communicate sensitively with patients and carers, recognising individual needs and treating everyone with dignity and respect. Recognise urgent concerns and promptly alert the appropriate clinician, following practice protocols. Raise complaints, concerns and incidents with the appropriate manager and follow practice reporting procedures. Work flexibly with colleagues to support reception cover and the smooth running of the practice.
